CustomField.description: Brand selections as comma-separated text for list views and related lists.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Brand__c), "", LEFT((IF(INCLUDES(Brand__c, "Cooling"), "Cooling, ", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Brand__c, "Ingénia"), "Ingénia, ", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Brand__c, "Patterson-Kelley"), "Patterson-Kelley, ", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Brand__c, "TAMCO"), "TAMCO, ", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Brand__c, "Marley"), "Marley, ", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Brand__c, "Strobic"), "Strobic, ", "")), LEN((IF(INCLUDES(Brand__c, "Cooling"), "Cooling, ", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Brand__c, "Ingénia"), "Ingénia, ", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Brand__c, "Patterson-Kelley"), "Patterson-Kelley, ", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Brand__c, "TAMCO"), "TAMCO, ", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Brand__c, "Marley"), "Marley, ", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Brand__c, "Strobic"), "Strobic, ", ""))) - 2))
CustomField.label: Brands
